units.source_text: 学生在山门苦又踌躇起来。

en.t: At the temple gate, the student began to hesitate painfully again.

units.source_text: 终于，他将身于靠在一根柱子上，从衣兜里掏出了刚才买来的香烟，然后慌里慌张地环视了四周。

en.t: At last, he leaned his body against a pillar, took from his pocket the cigarettes he had just bought, and then looked around in a panic.

units.source_text: 我心想；他准是借抽烟来引火吧。

en.t: I thought to myself: he must be using the act of smoking as a way to start the fire.

units.source_text: 果然不出所料，他嘴里叼着一支烟，凑近脸划着火柴。

en.t: Sure enough, just as I expected, he held a cigarette in his mouth and struck a match close to his face.
